settings.hero_desc: A precise 3D-printed model of a satellite component - dish antenna, body panels and structure reproduced in detail. A clean engineering replica for aerospace presentations, displays and education.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your component, scale, finish and base
settings.s1_body: We reproduce satellite and spacecraft components as accurate scale models, built from your CAD or drawings. This piece captures the dish antenna, body panels and internal structure in crisp detail - ideal for aerospace firms presenting hardware, education and outreach, or commemorating a mission with a tangible model.
settings.case_body: Built for an aerospace team, this component model turned complex hardware into something people could hold and understand - a clear presentation and outreach aid, and a fitting keepsake of the programme.
settings.case_quote: A beautifully accurate model of our hardware. Perfect for presentations and a great team keepsake.
settings.prov_p: Some engineering is hard to grasp from a screen. A precise physical model lets people hold it, turn it and understand it in seconds.
